## Summary

## Verification

- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Public API additions have nullable annotations, XML documentation, and `PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt` entries.
- [ ] README/API/architecture/release documentation is updated where applicable.
- [ ] Stream ownership, memory behavior, cancellation, failures, and zero-based page indexes remain explicit.
- [ ] Generated outputs and confidential test documents are not included.
